notes: I sampled five requirements. All were introduced at this step, because it is step 1 and there are no earlier requirements to pick from, so the 'earlier steps' part of the lens could not be applied. Each of the five can be matched to a test that asserts it: Target file, Refusing to replace an include, Folded block scalars, Byte-surgical write-back and Scalar quoting. But every match relies on scenario-like test names, not explicit links. No test cites a requirement or scenario ID. tasks.md names requirements but points at no test files, and getting from a test to src/troupe code means searching the repo.
